title: Mochizuki Honami — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Some other friends are here to express their gratitude to you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah, they're over there.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Ms. Yoisaki! Ena and Mizuki too!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hoshino contacted me, so I wanted to celebrate—um... I mean, participate in Gratitude Day.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I figured that Ena and Mizuki would be free, so I reached out to them and we came over here together.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Honami! Here's the gift all three of us picked out for you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They're accessories. We picked designs that weren't flashy, so I'm sure these would work with casual outfits too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wow, thank you very much!
I'll be sure to use these.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, wear them as much as you want.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We wanted to express our gratitude in some way. We're really thankful for you taking care of Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's my pleasure. But I don't really do all that much.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's not true at all. Thanks to you keeping the house so clean, I'm able to feel comfortable at home.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And you make meals that are easy to heat up and taste delicious, which helps me have more of an appetite.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's plenty amazing that you can get Kanade to eat proper meals, since she used to skip them without a second thought whenever she was in the zone.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: To be honest, we would love it if you could take care of Kanade forever.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'd be happy to.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ah, sorry. I need to head off for school soon.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We won't be able to join you for the rest either since we also have places to be soon, but please send our regards to the others♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The others...?
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Here's our last stop.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, they're here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Honami! Everybody!
Welcome wonderhoy♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh! I didn't realize you would all be here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We wouldn't miss it!
Thank you for always taking care of Saki!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you for being good friends with Nene, as well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, stop that. It's not like you're my dad.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But anyway, I'm glad that we became friends. Looking forward to spending more time together.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Me too!
You're my friend forever and ever, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I feel exactly the same.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And now, it is time for a special performance from Wonderlands×Showtime!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
You got this Tsukasa, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Today's show will be an interactive one, where the audience will be faced with decisions at certain moments.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Please discuss amongst yourselves and choose the option that will lead us to a happy ending.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow! Sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It does. Let's do our best, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Without further ado, the special show “Tensel and Emutel” will now begin.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Ena & Mizuki
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I heard that Tsukasa and his troupe's show was really good!
I wish I didn't have work so I could've seen it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I kind of wanted to see it too. But I heard from Emu that Honami enjoyed it, so that's all that matters.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah. We weren't able to stay until the very end, but I'm glad that we were able to give our birthday wishes in person.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh yeah, true that!
If you're ever free, let's hang out again sometime, Honami♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I heard from Kohane that you guys were able to get a happy ending! It's too bad this overlapped with work, otherwise we could've joined too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It was a show based on Hansel and Gretel that ended with them making peace with the Witch, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. It wasn't an easy journey, but thanks to Honami listening carefully to the Witch and knowing when to choose to fight back, we got there in the end.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure Honami's kindness helped you all find the path that led to everyone being happy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. Mochizuki is such a wonderful and caring person.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She is. I hope you never change, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Honami! Happy birthday!
Good job in choosing to meet with the Witch again at the finale of the show! It wasn't an easy choice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If you had picked otherwise and the kids went on their way, it would've led to the Witch chasing them down and caused more conflict.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean, the actual tale of Hansel and Gretel ends with them defeating the Witch and getting to return home, so that would've been fine too...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But then Honami was like “we don't know anything about her, so we shouldn't assume she's a bad person. I'd like to let them meet again.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The way Mochizuki made those decisions was so cool. I want to learn to have that same kind of strength.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hona! How did you like Gratitude Day?
Did you have fun?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She was having a hard time deciding which choice to make at certain points in the show, but I guess that just means she was serious about it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Honami was a lot more invested in the characters' happiness than any of us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, it was just a show... But it's very much like her to give it that much thought.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, we can't keep relying on Honami's kindness all the time, so we need to put in the work too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You said it! If anything, we should be spoiling Hona like we did today!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I guess you heard it here, Honami.
Just remember that you can rely on us now and again, okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The Gratitude Day Saki and the others prepared really was fun.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I didn't think so many people would be a part of it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Getting all these wonderful birthday wishes makes me want to work even harder this year.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you for wishing me a happy birthday too, everyone.
Let's meet again in SEKAI.
